PWU_Make_AIPersonaCore.description.english: Assemble a persona core: a hyper-advanced computer core housing a peak-human-equivalent machine persona. In isolation it is dormant. Installed in a proper support structure, such as a starship or the hilt of a bladelink weapon, it becomes a mind of great power.

PWU_Make_MonoSword.description.english: Craft a monosword: a crystal-metallic longsword infused with mechanites that maintain a mono-molecular cutting edge. Persona-convert it at a fabrication bench afterward to awaken its bladelink traits.

PWU_Make_PlasmaSword.description.english: Craft a plasmasword: a metal-cored sword wrapped in a plasma sheath that slices and burns. Persona-convert it at a fabrication bench afterward to awaken its bladelink traits.

PWU_Make_Zeushammer.description.english: Craft a zeushammer: a warhammer with an embedded EMP capacitor that blasts targets with an EMP burst on impact. Persona-convert it at a fabrication bench afterward to awaken its bladelink traits.

PWU_BladelinkCustomization.description.english: Reprogram the AI personas bonded to bladelink weapons. Install a persona core to awaken a weapon's persona and unlock its traits for editing, then rewire those traits at a fabrication bench using advanced components.
